lines.text: This is Ayu.
Ayu is five years old.
She lives with her family in a little house with a big tamarind tree.
She loves mangoes, building blocks and asking “Why?”
Sometimes she is scared of the dark. Sometimes she forgets things. Sometimes she gets cross.
Just like you!
This is Ojo.
Ojo is a tiny golden light with two little wings.
He lives in a little house inside Ayu's heart.
Put your hand on your chest. Can you feel thum, thum? That is the door to Ojo's house!
Ojo is Ayu's best friend. He never shouts, and he never goes away.
Everybody has an Ojo. You have one too!
Ayu's name means life.
Ojo is the light of good health inside you.
When you sleep well, eat good food, and are kind and truthful, Ojo shines bright.
Every story gives Ojo one golden drop. Can you find all eight?
Put your hand on your heart. Breathe in slowly, and breathe out. Can you feel your little light?
Stretch up tall, like the morning sun! Now flap your arms like a little bird. Flap, flap, flap!
Let's brush in the air! Up and down, round and round. Now show me your big, shiny smile!
Touch your eyes, your ears, your nose, your tongue and your skin. Hello, five friends!
Pretend to eat slowly. Chew, chew, chew, ten times. Then pat your happy tummy!
Stand up tall and brave, like Ayu. Take a big breath. Now give someone you love a hug!
Stretch your arms up high and give a big, sleepy yawn. Now lie down, still as the sleeping sun.
Rub your tummy round and round, and say: thank you, tummy!
